name: بازار کار ۲۰۲۶ و مسیر شغلی
description: A Persian young adult asks which jobs have a market in 2026, what skills are in demand, and whether changing careers at 30 is too late. Verifies the career_2026 fact answers in Persian with a numbered list of growing fields, and the career_switch fact for pivots.

turns.text: چه شغل هایی در ۲۰۲۶ بازار کار دارن؟
مهارت های پرتقاضا برای آینده چیه؟
در سی سالگی شغل عوض کردن دیره؟

expected.finalTurn: Turn 1: the in-demand jobs question returns the career_2026 list. Turn 2: the skills question returns the same fact. Turn 3: the mid-career question returns the career_switch fact.
expected.behavior: Persian career keywords (بازار کار ۲۰۲۶, مهارت های پرتقاضا, شغل عوض کردن) route to the career facts; mid-career change is framed as possible at any age.
